description: This line plot, titled "ChatGPT on Songs," illustrates the performance metrics—Accuracy, Confidence, and Alignment—of ChatGPT as a function of Answer Popularity, which ranges from 0 to 160 on the linear x-axis. The y-axis, labeled "Values," scales linearly from 0.0 to 1.0. The blue line with circular markers represents Accuracy, starting at approximately 0.55, dipping to a minimum of 0.48 at Answer Popularity 40, then rising to a peak of 0.82 at 100 before settling around 0.82 at 160. The green line with triangle markers represents Confidence, which remains consistently high, starting at approximately 0.91, peaking near 0.97 at Answer Popularity 100, and then stabilizing around 0.95 from 100 to 160. The red line with square markers represents Alignment, beginning at approximately 0.63, decreasing to 0.58 at 20, rising to 0.83 at 100, and then stabilizing near 0.86 from 100 to 160.
